Our engineering team maintains a local mirror of critical open-source libraries at `/workspace/github_repos`. The current inventory file there is badly out of date and is missing several repos. We need you to do two things:

1. There's a machine learning utilities library we need added to our local collection. Its source is available at `/workspace/bare_remotes/ml-utils.git`. Please download it into our standard local repository folder at `/workspace/github_repos`.

2. After that, rebuild the team's repository inventory so it accurately reflects everything currently in `/workspace/github_repos`. The inventory file is `CLAUDE.md` and lives inside that same folder.

The scripts needed to regenerate the inventory are in `/workspace/scripts/`. Once done, the `CLAUDE.md` should list only the real repositories (git-tracked projects) with their local paths and descriptions — nothing else.
